description: The same checked facts for 2 to 5 tokens, side by side: price, market cap and whether the sources agree on it, commits by people over 90 days, fees over 30 days, real market cap and days to sell it, owner powers, top-10 wallet share, unlocks in 30 days, signals in the last month. No ranking. Use for “X or Y” and “compare these” questions.
